mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "A" names the set represented by the indicated circle. Right image: The symbol "A" names a specific geometric point at the indicated location.
Rationales: The left occurrence is A below the red circle with 4, 8 and 13 on its left-only side. The right occurrence is A at the common endpoint of the three slanted segments. The left placement shows that the symbol names the set represented by the indicated circle, while the right placement shows that it names a specific geometric point at the indicated location.
